thread:
ashley: Quick preflight handoff for tonight's change window (22:00-23:00 UTC). Need final pin + smoke + rollback ack. TL;DR checklist: 1) pin model-serving -> v2.3.1, 2) disable autoscale during canary, 3) run smoke.sh and sanity prompts, 4) confirm rollback thresholds and playbook link. pinging @mike @tara for infra/qa handoff. deploy-bot, can you report pin status?

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Pin job queued: `pin-service model-serving v2.3.1` (job id 98321). Waiting on infra locks.

mike: infra ack — reserved pool sized to 12 GPUs for the window, network ACLs checked. I'll grab the handoff in 30m.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Pin applied: model-serving -> v2.3.1 on prod-nodes (4/4). Artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/model-serving/v2.3.1.

tara: QA update: canary smoke on staging passed. Ran `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite=canary --timeout=90s` and spot checks for hallucination regression (prompt set A) are OK. I'll start prod canary at 21:50 UTC and report.

emma: Rollback plan posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback.md . Quick criteria: latency > 500ms p50 sustained 5m OR error rate > 2% over 5m => trigger rollback to v2.3.0. Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback model-serving --to v2.3.0 --force-if-degraded`. Ops will be notified automatically.

leo: Note — embeddings-worker is on dedicated infra and not part of the standard pin flow. I will coordinate a manual pin for that pool at +15m.

sre-oncall: I'm on standby. I'll watch SLO dashboard and set alert threshold to warn at 300ms p50 and critical at 500ms. Have runbooks open.

opsbot: :calendar: Change window scheduled: 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z - 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Reminder in #eng-releases 30m before start.

ashley: Great — two quick asks: (1) confirm autoscale toggled for canary (mike), (2) QA to post final canary timestamp and results (tara). After both, I'll mark GO for the window.

mike: autoscale disabled for the canary group (`asg-canary-models`) — verified.

tara: starting prod canary at 21:50 UTC. Will post `canary:pass` or `canary:fail` in this thread within 10m of start.

ashley: Thanks — handing off to @mike and @tara. If canary:pass, proceed with rolling canary then full rollout. If canary:fail, follow rollback playbook. :thumbsup:

mike: confirmed handoff. I'll kick off the canary sequence at 21:50 and tag SRE if anything spikes.

tara: canary:pass — 21:51 UTC. Latency and error rate in green. Proceeding to 10% traffic ramp now.

emma: Acknowledged. Monitoring thresholds set and rollback command at the ready.

leo: embeddings-worker pin done (manual): v1.9.8 pinned on dedicated-pool.

sre-oncall: All good from SRE. No abnormal alerts during initial ramp.

ashley: GO for full rollout. I'll publish the release notes and close this handoff. Thanks team! :tada:
